body.text: Initial acceptance passes all 16 tests on Python 3.9.6. Review found README missing-ID example says no task with id 99, actual store says Task ID 99 not found: please correct example. Please strengthen tests within current frozen scope: shuffled on-disk tasks to truly test sorting; invalid nested schema (bool/duplicate IDs, next_id <= max, nonbool done, blank title) against list/add/done with unchanged bytes; invalid UTF-8; patch os.replace to fail and verify original bytes survive/temp cleaned. No interface/output change needed. Can you add these before submitting?
